content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make a budget, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Gather all physical receipts from the last month (20 minutes)
Step 2. Download electronic bank statements (10 minutes)
Step 3. Calculate average monthly grocery spending (45 minutes)
Step 4. Identify recurring monthly subscriptions (15 minutes)
Step 5. Categorize discretionary spending habits (2 hours)
Step 6. Summarize total monthly expenses (1 hour)
Step 7. List upcoming one-time annual fees (30 minutes)
Step 8. Compare total spending against net income (30 minutes)
Step 9. Verify interest earned on savings accounts (10 minutes)
Step 10. Research better interest rates for emergency funds (1 hour)
Step 11. Finalize the budget spreadsheet (2 hours)
Step 12. Audit utility bills for seasonal fluctuations (40 minutes)
Step 13. Estimate costs for holiday gifts and travel (1.5 hours)
Step 14. Review credit card reward point balances (20 minutes)
Step 15. Set a target amount for monthly savings (25 minutes)
Step 16. Determine maximum affordable rent or mortgage (50 minutes)
Step 17. Calculate the debt-to-income ratio (30 minutes)
Step 18. Check current balances on student loans (15 minutes)
Step 19. Allocate funds for a new car down payment (10 minutes)
Step 20. Export transaction data to a CSV file (5 minutes)
Step 21. Log into all investment portals (15 minutes)
Step 22. Print the finalized monthly budget report (5 minutes)
Step 23. Analyze food delivery and dining out costs (1 hour)
Step 24. Look up current gas prices for commute estimates (10 minutes)
Step 25. Identify potential areas for cost-cutting (45 minutes)
Step 26. Sort transactions by vendor name (20 minutes)
Step 27. Establish spending limits for each category (1.5 hours)
Step 28. Factor in a buffer for unexpected repairs (40 minutes)
Step 29. Check the balance of the primary checking account (5 minutes)
Step 30. Collect login credentials for all financial apps (30 minutes)
Step 31. Archive last year's financial records (1 hour)
Step 32. Review entertainment and hobby expenses (1 hour)
Step 33. Evaluate portfolio performance for the quarter (2 hours)
Step 34. Estimate annual tax liability (3 hours)
Step 35. Check for any fraudulent or duplicate charges (45 minutes)
Step 36. Calculate total projected annual surplus (1 hour)
Step 37. List home maintenance requirements (2 hours)
Step 38. Calculate total household monthly income (30 minutes)
Step 39. Estimate monthly healthcare out-of-pocket costs (40 minutes)
Step 40. Review insurance policy premiums (1 hour)
Step 41. Gather all outstanding debt statements (25 minutes)
Step 42. Look up current clothing and personal care needs (30 minutes)
Step 43. Organize paper receipts into a folder (15 minutes)
Step 44. Calculate total monthly debt obligations (30 minutes)
Step 45. Review cell phone and internet plans (45 minutes)
Step 46. Estimate monthly transportation and fuel costs (20 minutes)
Step 47. Check the balance of the retirement account (10 minutes)
Step 48. Set up automatic transfers to savings (15 minutes)
Step 49. Clean up the physical home office space (1 hour)
Step 50. Review the previous year's tax return (2 hours)
Step 51. Update the password manager with financial sites (45 minutes)
Step 52. Determine the size of the emergency fund needed (1 hour)
Step 53. Search for better car insurance quotes (2 hours)
Step 54. Adjust the 401k contribution percentage (15 minutes)
Step 55. Record the current value of all liquid assets (20 minutes)
Step 56. Calculate the total net worth (1.5 hours)
Step 57. Review the current credit score (10 minutes)
Step 58. Identify all active credit cards (15 minutes)
Step 59. Calculate the total available credit limit (30 minutes)
Step 60. Request a free annual credit report (15 minutes)
